description: Fact-check one claim against live retrieved sources. Opt-in AI service: a language model labels each source's stance. Returns verdict (supported, refuted or unverified), sufficiency, a conformal guarantee, per-part atoms and a signed provenance receipt binding the evidence and model route. Sufficiency other than sufficient (insufficient, no_sources, no_stance, conflict) is a reason to abstain or escalate. When guarantee.certified is true, the error probability is calibrated to at most guarantee.alpha, so supported plus certified is the strongest signal; a person or a rule decides. Compound claims are verified part by part and recombined weakest-link. Limits: evidence is web, encyclopedic and news sources, so very recent, private, niche or opinion claims return unverified or insufficient. The guarantee exists only on calibrated deployments, for claims exchangeable with the calibration set, which holds no finance figures. It checks source support, not ultimate truth. Free.

claim.description: The factual claim as ONE complete declarative sentence (not a question or a paragraph).

max_sources.description: How many sources to retrieve and weigh (1-10).
